description: Embedded ML decomposed. TFLite Micro architecture, CMSIS-NN kernels, quantization (post-training + QAT), pruning, knowledge distillation, neuromorphic accelerators, edge inference hardware (Ethos-U, NPU).

sub_mechanisms.name: TFLite_Micro_runtime
sub_mechanisms.definition: ~16 KB runtime. No allocator (static memory plan). Interprets FlatBuffer model.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard MCU ML runtime. Supports common ops; falls back to reference. Kernel registration: link only used ops.

sub_mechanisms.name: CMSIS_NN_kernels
sub_mechanisms.definition: ARM-optimised NN kernels. Hand-tuned per Cortex-M variant. Used by TFLite Micro on ARM.
sub_mechanisms.why: 5-10x faster than reference. Uses M4/M7 DSP extensions, M55 MVE. Critical for practical MCU inference.

sub_mechanisms.name: post_training_quantization
sub_mechanisms.definition: Train float; convert to int8. Calibration set used to determine activation ranges.
sub_mechanisms.why: Easy: no retraining. Cost: ~1-2% accuracy loss. Sufficient for many applications. Standard first step.

sub_mechanisms.name: quantization_aware_training
sub_mechanisms.definition: QAT: simulate quantization during training. Network adapts to quantization effects.
sub_mechanisms.why: Better accuracy than PTQ, especially at int4/int2. Cost: longer training. Used when PTQ accuracy insufficient.

sub_mechanisms.name: structured_pruning
sub_mechanisms.definition: Remove entire channels/filters. Network becomes smaller + faster.
sub_mechanisms.why: Compatible with hardware (no sparsity needed). Cost: more accuracy loss than unstructured. Often combined with QAT.

sub_mechanisms.name: knowledge_distillation_embedded
sub_mechanisms.definition: Train small student to mimic large teacher's outputs.
sub_mechanisms.why: Compress capability into smaller model. Student size = deployable to MCU. Better than training small from scratch.

sub_mechanisms.name: Ethos_U_microNPU
sub_mechanisms.definition: ARM's Ethos-U55/U65: NPU for Cortex-M. ~256 MAC/cycle. ~50x faster than M4F.
sub_mechanisms.why: Dedicated AI accelerator for MCU. ~$1 silicon cost. Used in modern Cortex-M55 designs. Game-changer for MCU AI.

sub_mechanisms.name: edge_TPU_coral
sub_mechanisms.definition: Google Edge TPU. 4 TOPS. For SBC + cameras.
sub_mechanisms.why: Dedicated inference at low power (~2W). Coral Dev Board, USB Accelerator. Bigger than MCU; smaller than data center.

sub_mechanisms.name: neuromorphic_chips
sub_mechanisms.definition: Spiking neural network hardware. Loihi (Intel), Akida (BrainChip), TrueNorth (IBM).
sub_mechanisms.why: Event-driven compute. Ultra-low power for sparse signals. Research → emerging products. Different paradigm than dense matrix.

sub_mechanisms.name: model_optimization_toolkit
sub_mechanisms.definition: TensorFlow Model Optimization. Pruning, quantization, clustering APIs.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard pipeline: train → optimise → convert. Reduces model size + inference cost. Standard for production embedded ML.

sub_mechanisms.name: anomaly_detection_embedded
sub_mechanisms.definition: Detect unusual sensor patterns. Autoencoders, one-class SVM, statistical methods.
sub_mechanisms.why: Industrial predictive maintenance. Vibration → anomaly score. Local inference avoids cloud bandwidth + latency.

sub_mechanisms.name: wake_word_detection
sub_mechanisms.definition: Always-on keyword spotting. <50 KB models. <1mA average current.
sub_mechanisms.why: Alexa, Google Assistant, Hey Siri. Dedicated micro accelerator (Cortex-M, Hexagon) for always-on. Standard voice UX.

derivation_rules.name: quantization_essential_for_no_FPU_inference
then: int8 quantization is required for practical inference
derivation_rules.why: Software float on Cortex-M0: 100s of cycles per op. Int8 native + ~1 cycle per MAC with DSP. 50-100x speedup. Quality acceptable.

derivation_rules.name: CMSIS_NN_dominates_reference_kernels
then: 5-10x faster than reference TFLite Micro kernels
derivation_rules.why: Hand-tuned assembly using DSP + SIMD extensions. M4F MVE provides multi-element ops. CMSIS-NN library bridges. Standard for ARM embedded ML.

derivation_rules.name: Ethos_U_NPU_changes_what_fits_on_MCU
derivation_rules.definition: Tiny NPU dramatically expands MCU ML capability.
then: MobileNet-class models become real-time on MCU
derivation_rules.why: Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U55: 256 MACs/cycle vs M4F 1 MAC/cycle. Object detection, larger keyword sets, image classification feasible. New class of MCU capability.

derivation_rules.name: knowledge_distillation_beats_training_small
then: distillation outperforms training small from scratch
derivation_rules.why: Small model trained alone: limited by capacity. Distilled from larger teacher: soft labels carry richer info. Empirical 2-5% accuracy improvement.

derivation_rules.name: local_inference_for_privacy_and_latency
derivation_rules.why: Wake words: privacy + always-on (cloud impractical). Industrial anomaly detection: ms response, no internet dependency. Standard embedded ML drivers.
